comment: I have no idea what happened, but this guy has changed. I have never had a more enjoyable lecture class, or one where it felt like the teacher so truly wanted people to do well. He gave us a previous exam to study off of (and reviewed it in class). It's a 40 question multiple choice. Every class feels like an engaging conversation.
I think he has changed ... he knows what he is talking about and i think he is interested in what you have to say as a student.
terrible prof. Proves the adage "those who can, do; those who can't, teach." Although he can't teach, I would not want to see him as an administrator. He brings very little to the study of law.

I agree, Prof. Eisen must have changed over the years.  He is one of my favorite professors.  I must admit that he is not an easy professor, but I did end up taking him again for Environmental Law.  He has been great in that class too...though he is a Nicolas Cage fan, which I just don't get ;)

Eisen must have changed over the years because he is hands down my favorite professor. His explanations in class were clear and he was great at stimulating discussion. I went to his office a few times and he was great about answering my questions and seemed genuinely interested in my longterm legal interests. I would def take another class with him
Very condascending. Wouldn't take this class again.

Yes, kind of condescending-- but he no longer makes comments about "where he lives" or "what he drives" as some of the other posters complained. I thought this was a good class and I would take a class with him again if I needed to.

He is a jerk. He'll sit there and tell the class how stupid they are, and then just keep teaching, expecting people to care. As stated, he is very arrogant and pompous - and guess what, his wife, who is teaching at the school now, is the same way!

This man is a jackass.  Pompous and arrogant.  He's an academic, not an experienced lawyer. He demeans students regularly.  constantly "bragging" about where he lives and what he drives.  I attempted to approach numerous times with questions about the material and he never gave me an answer - once he simply walked away!  He is a small man.
Best professor i've had
he is an ass. The most repulsive, stereotypical law professor out there.

Loves the ladies, comes across like a total buffoon. Wants so badly to be Berryhill, but lacks the sense of humor to pull it off. Not to mention, who would want to be like Berryhill??? Environmental is an easy course, however. So I guess he gets points for

The stereotypical law professor. Snide comments, rude to students. It seems his goal for each semester is to make someone cry. Hated it, hated the course. And like the previous comment, he is definitely NOT Wade Berryhill.
